ax.set_ylim(0, 10)
ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('(b) Diagnostic Chain', fontweight='bold', pad=8)

steps = [
    ('①', 'Gate Analysis',    'Gates learn correctly (TF GAR = 0.50)', True),
    ('②', 'PCGrad Exclusion', 'Gradient conflict not the cause',      False),
    ('③', 'TRC Analysis',     'Representations intact (AUC = 0.98)',   False),
    ('④', 'Conclusion',       'Exposure bias identified',              True),
]

y_positions = [8.5, 6.3, 4.1, 1.7]
left_x = 0.5
arrow_x = 5.0

for i, ((num, method, conclusion, is_positive), y) in enumerate(zip(steps, y_positions)):
    # Background highlight for final conclusion row
    if i == len(steps) - 1:
        rect = mpatches.FancyBboxPatch((0.2, y - 0.65), 9.6, 1.5,
                                        boxstyle='round,pad=0.2',
                                        facecolor=C_CONCL_BG, alpha=0.5,
                                        edgecolor=C_GREEN, linewidth=0.8)
        ax.add_patch(rect)
    
    # Step number + method name (bold)
    ax.text(left_x, y + 0.15, f'{num} {method}', fontsize=7.5,
            fontweight='bold', va='center', ha='left', color='#222222')
    
    # Arrow separator + conclusion
    mark = '✓' if is_positive else '✗'
    mark_color = C_GREEN if is_positive else C_GRAY
    ax.text(left_x + 0.15, y - 0.55, f'→ {conclusion}  ',
            fontsize=6.5, va='center', ha='left', color='#555555')
    ax.text(9.5, y - 0.55, mark, fontsize=8, va='center', ha='right',
            color=mark_color, fontweight='bold')
    
    # Connecting arrow to next step
    if i < len(steps) - 1:
        y_next = y_positions[i + 1]
        ax.annotate('', xy=(arrow_x, y_next + 0.65), xytext=(arrow_x, y - 0.85),
                    arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#BBBBBB', lw=1.0,
                                    shrinkA=0, shrinkB=0))

# ======== Panel (c): Constructive Evidence ========
ax = axes[2]
betas = [0, 3, 5]
ar_gar = [0.064, 0.532, 0.704]

ax.fill_between(betas, ar_gar, alpha=0.15, color=C_BLUE, zorder=1)
ax.plot(betas, ar_gar, 'o-', color=C_BLUE, markersize=6,
        markerfacecolor='white', markeredgecolor=C_BLUE, markeredgewidth=1.5,
        zorder=3)

ax.set_xlabel('β')
ax.set_ylabel('AR Mid-turn GAR')
ax.set_title('(c) Constructive Evidence', fontweight='bold', pad=8)
ax.set_xticks(betas)
ax.set_ylim(0, 0.85)
ax.set_xlim(-0.5, 5.8)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.2, zorder=0)

ax.annotate('11× recovery', xy=(5, 0.704), xytext=(3.0, 0.78),
            fontsize=7, color=C_BLUE, fontweight='bold',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color=C_BLUE, lw=0.8),
            va='center')

# Fix: all labels ABOVE data points
for b, g in zip(betas, ar_gar):
    ax.text(b, g + 0.03, f'{g:.3f}', fontsize=6, ha='center', va='bottom',
            color='#555555')

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=1.5)

outdir = '/root/turn-residual-gating/artifacts'
os.makedirs(outdir, exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, 'fig1_overview_v3.pdf'))
fig.savefig(os.path.join(outdir, 'fig1_overview_v3.png'), dpi=300)
plt.close()
print('Done: fig1_overview_v3.pdf + fig1_overview_v3.png')
PYEOF
